Definition: from the same as G5364; fondness of mankind, i.e. benevolence ("philanthropy"):--kindness, love towards man.
BiblicalUsage: Philanthropia is love for mankind, kindness toward strangers, and it appears twice. The barbarians on Malta show Paul and his companions no little kindness, kindling a fire and receiving them because of the rain, and Paul says that after the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared, He saved us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe human kindness on a rainy shore is the picture of God's kindness: strangers take in the shipwrecked, and God takes in the sinner, both asking nothing first.
